info.name: Blaze Flow API
info.description: Executable collection for the currently implemented Blaze Flow Django API

request.description: Public health endpoint
Register the account currently stored in the email/password variables
Start a Django session and capture its CSRF token

Exchange a Google-issued ID token for a Blaze Flow session. Requires GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID to be set server-side and a real id_token from a Google Sign-In flow for the same client ID (Postman cannot generate one itself); returns 400 with a clear message if the server has no client ID configured. A verified Google email auto-links to a matching registered account; an unverified one is rejected rather than silently linked. A first-time verified sign-in creates the account, marks its email verified, and provisions a FREE subscription, the same as Register
Return the authenticated user
Always returns 202. Copy the token query parameter from the delivered development email into reset_token.
Always returns 202. Copy the token query parameter from the delivered development email into verification_token.
End the current session
Read the current user's subscription and effective plan limits. Accounts registered before this feature existed have no stored row; a FREE default is returned without creating one

Simulate upgrading to the PRO plan (no external payment provider is integrated). Sets a period of SUBSCRIPTION_PRO_PERIOD_DAYS (default 30). Fails with 400 if already on an active, non-cancelling PRO subscription

Schedule cancellation at the end of the current period (cancel_at_period_end). The plan stays PRO until an operator runs the process_expired_subscriptions command after the period ends. Fails with 400 if there is no active PRO subscription or one is already scheduled to cancel
Undo a pending cancellation while still within the current period. Fails with 400 if nothing is scheduled to cancel
List workspaces readable by the current user

Create a workspace, system roles, workflow stages, and owner membership. Requires a verified email; returns 403 otherwise. Complete the Email Verification request first if the current session's account is unverified. Also fails with 400 once the account already owns its plan's max_workspaces_owned limit (FREE defaults to 1); run Subscriptions -> Upgrade to PRO first if you need more than one test workspace on the same account.
Read a single workspace
Update name and/or timezone. Requires workspace.manage. The slug cannot be changed
Read the optional business profile. Returns empty fields until a manager sets any of them; no row is created by reading
Create or update the business profile. Requires workspace.manage

Move the workspace to PENDING_DELETION with a grace period (WORKSPACE_DELETION_GRACE_DAYS, default 30). This does not physically delete anything and can be undone with Restore Workspace. Run this only at the end of a manual test pass
Cancel a pending deletion and return the workspace to ACTIVE. Fails with 400 if the workspace is not currently PENDING_DELETION
List workspace roles and their permission keys
Create a custom workspace role
Update a non-system role
Archive an unassigned custom role
List workspace membership principals
Update a non-owner membership
Soft-remove a non-owner membership
Create a single-use invitation and capture its raw token
Accept as an authenticated user whose email matches invitation_email
List client organizations in the workspace
Create a client organization. Requires client_team.manage
Read a single client organization
Update client organization profile fields
List active and removed members of the client organization
Add an existing registered user as a client team member, or reactivate a previously removed one
Soft-remove a client team member

Create the CLIENT_TEAM workspace membership so active team members inherit this role and project access mode. Requires workspace.members.manage. Update or revoke afterward through Update Member / Remove Member using the returned membership id
List invitations for the client team. Never exposes the stored token hash
Create a single-use, recipient-bound invite. The raw token is returned once
Create a shareable, reusable invite not bound to one recipient. max_uses is optional; omit it for unlimited use until expiration/revocation

Accept as an authenticated user. An EMAIL invite requires the logged-in account's email to match recipient_email; a LINK invite accepts any authenticated user up to max_uses. Re-accepting the same invite as the same user is idempotent
Revoke an invite. Already-exchanged access it granted is not retroactively removed; use Remove Client Team Member for that
Archive the client organization. Existing team members immediately lose inherited access; run this last
List projects within the current users effective scope

Create a project. Fails with 400 once the workspace already holds its owner's plan max_projects_per_workspace limit (FREE defaults to 3, counting non-archived projects); the owner can run Subscriptions -> Upgrade to PRO to raise it
Read an authorized project
Update an authorized project
Archive rather than physically delete the project
List explicit SELECTED-scope grants
Grant the project to an active SELECTED membership
Revoke an explicit project grant
List active folders as a flat list; assemble the tree client-side using parent_folder_id
Create a root-level folder. Omit parent_folder_id for root; set it to nest inside an existing folder. Names must be unique among siblings
Rename a folder. A folder cannot be moved to a different parent through this endpoint
List active project files (root and foldered)

Upload a supporting project file. Enable the folder_id field to place it inside a folder instead of the project root. Accepts the same signature-verified types as review/task attachments (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, PDF, WAV, MP3, MP4, QuickTime, WebM, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, RTF) and is queued for malware scanning the same way
Remove the file from the project. The underlying File record is retained
Delete a folder. Cascades to descendant folders and the files inside them; underlying File records are retained. Run this last
List active workspace-level tasks plus tasks in projects you can access
Create a workspace-level task with no project. Omit project_id for workspace-level work; set it to scope the task to a project you can access
Create a task scoped to a project. Requires task.create at the workspace level plus project access to project_id
Read a single task
Update task fields. Setting status to COMPLETED stamps completed_at; moving off COMPLETED clears it. project_id cannot be changed here
List workspace memberships assigned to the task
Assign a workspace membership to the task
Remove an assignee from the task
List files attached to the task

Upload a supporting file. Accepts the same signature-verified types as review attachments (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, PDF, WAV, MP3) plus MP4/QuickTime/WebM and DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/RTF. The file is queued for malware scanning like other uploads
Remove the attachment association. The underlying File record is retained, matching the project-files convention
Soft-delete the task. Requires task.delete (Owner role by default; Member does not have it)
List authorized project media versions
List active stages and capture In Review for the transition request
Upload an image/video and allocate the next project version
Read media metadata and current workflow stage
Download the private object when allow_download is enabled
Stream the generated review proxy or preview with media.read permission; returns 404 until background preview processing finishes
Read the ordered stage history for the media version
Atomically close the current stage entry and enter In Review
Create a top-level time-range comment and capture its ID
List active comments and replies in creation order
Idempotently add the current user's reaction and return updated comment aggregates
Remove only the current user's matching reaction

request.description: Upload a signature-verified private attachment to your own comment
Download an attachment through project-scoped authorization
Soft-delete as the comment author or comment manager; run after download testing
Create a structured mention after the invited member has project read access
Reply without separate timing; replies inherit their thread context
Edit the original author's comment and preserve its previous snapshot
Read immutable snapshots captured before edits
Resolve a top-level thread; requires review.comment.manage
Reopen a resolved top-level thread
Atomically create feedback and move the media to the Revision stage
Soft-delete the comment and all active descendants; run last
Create normalized visual markup and capture its ID
List active markup for the media version
Replace annotation elements and preserve the previous snapshot
Read immutable pre-edit annotation snapshots
Soft-delete using annotation.manage; run last
Workspace-manager view of outbox and delivery counts
Read the workspace override or effective environment-default review-file policy
Create or update the audited workspace review-file retention override
Manager-only scan, preview/outbox, delivery, and alert-state report
Manager-only Prometheus text exposition for workspace operations.
Read the authenticated user's delivery preferences
Enable or disable mention emails without affecting the in-app inbox
List only the authenticated recipient's unread notifications
Idempotently mark one recipient-owned notification as read
Mark all unread notifications for the authenticated user as read

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set("guest_invite_token", data.token); pm.collectionVariables.set("guest_invite_id", data.id); }

Replaces the guest key immediately and captures the one-time replacement
Revokes one exchanged guest session; run lifecycle deletes last
